quest.title: Friendships, Wishes, and Regrets
quest.description: Meng tells you that Big G is his childhood friend, who died by misadventure. Filled with regret and worry, Meng believes that due to a supernatural turn of events, Big G has become an evil spirit. Luocheng, another superstitious person who believes in ghost stories just like Meng, visits the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor seeking an exorcism. However, Hu Tao knows that the source of their worries is imaginary, so she comes up with an equally make-believe solution and organizes a fake exorcism. Surprisingly, the spirit of Big G appears before your eyes after the ritual.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Mora x34075, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

talks.objective: Return to Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and find out what happened

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After all that's happened, Paimon's not even sure what's going on anymore.

choices.text: I didn't expect to stumble upon Big G just like that either.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Actually, I'm not surprised in the slightest. Remember what I said? There's only so many evil spirits in this world.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: It was a twist of fate that made him leave Wuwang Hill in the first place. Now, for some reason, he can't go back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This explanation sounds a bit far-fetched to Paimon.

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: Actually... she pretty much summed it up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehh!?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Hehe, don't ever question my professional instincts!

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: I just wanted to check up on my friends. That's why I came to Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: I promise I wasn't up to any mischief! I never wanted to scare anyone!

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: A few days ago, some people came to Wuwang Hill on a dare. I heard them saying they'd come from Liyue Harbor, so I followed one of them back and ended up here.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Ah, it must've been poor Luocheng that you followed. Maybe he didn't notice you, but he could still feel your presence. Now we know what caused his nightmares.

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: I—I was discovered?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Well, I assume so, otherwise he wouldn't have been scared half to death.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why didn't you come looking for Meng sooner?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Hu Tao and Meng were searching for you all over the place.

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: Oh, that's because I couldn't find them. It's my first time in Liyue Harbor and I got lost in the city.

response.speaker: Meng
response.text: Now that you mention it, Big G always had a poor sense of direction. When we were kids, he'd never go down the hill by himself. We always had to lead him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So all of this was just because you got lost!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why didn't you just fly? Like any other ghost or spirit? Don't you think it's much easier to find your way from up above?

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: I... can't.

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: It's too high for me, I'd get scared.

response.speaker: Meng
response.text: That's right, yes! He used to be so afraid of heights that he wouldn't even so much as look down the hill.

response.speaker: Meng
response.text: Hahaha, you haven't changed a bit!

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: I knew I wasn't supposed to show myself to the living, and with so many people walking around Liyue Harbor, my only choice was to hide.

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: I wouldn't have found you if it weren't for the Ley Line Monolith's call.

response.speaker: Meng
response.text: I'm so relieved that you haven't become an evil spirit...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Like I said, don't ever doubt my professional instincts. Now, all we have to do is escort this lost child back to Wuwang Hill, and we should be done and dust-to-dusted!

response.speaker: Meng
response.text: But he just said that he wanted to visit his friends. Apart from me, there's also Little Wu, Mumu, and Congzi.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Well... if that's the case, we can't let him down. We'll ask them all to help us prepare a farewell ceremony for Big G.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Meng and I will escort Big G back to Wuwang Hill. You meet with those three and ask them for keepsakes to symbolize each one of them during the ritual, then come and find us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They're all friends, can't we just go there all together? Or maybe we can take Big G to them?

response.speaker: Big G
response.text: Um... That's not a good idea. I don't want to scare them.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Hmm, I wouldn't want ordinary folks to become superstitious... The less they know, the better.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: So be careful what you say when you collect the keepsakes!

choices.text: Good thing they didn't call you "Tall G..."
So Big G's not an evil spirit?

talks.objective: Ask Little Wu for a keepsake

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Hi... Eh-he... Do you remember us?

dialogues.speaker: Little Wu
dialogues.text: Ugh, you... Sorry, I won't be needing the funeral parlor's services anytime soon.

response.speaker: Little Wu
response.text: Yes, we grew up together. We still keep in touch even now.

response.speaker: Little Wu
response.text: I don't know why he started working for Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. To be honest, I find their director to be quite peculiar.

response.speaker: Little Wu
response.text: But he must've had his reasons. He's on his own now after all, and he still can't get over what happened to Big G.

response.speaker: Little Wu
response.text: Did he tell you about it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, he did. Um, if you could pick one thing to give to Big G as a keepsake, what would you choose?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Just, y'know, theoretically speaking. We're just being hypothetical here, definitely not gonna actually go commemorate him or anything...

choices.text: (That's a little bit on the nose.)

response.speaker: Little Wu
response.text: I'd cook something for him. He could eat spicy food like no other. His favorite meal was extra-spicy Jueyun Chili Chicken.

response.speaker: Little Wu
response.text: I can make it for you if you bring me some Jueyun Chilis.

response.speaker: Little Wu
response.text: I'm sure he'd appreciate the flavor of his childhood years. I still use that old recipe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Deal! Just give us a minute!

choices.text: Meng said that he's an old friend of yours.

talks.objective: Find Jueyun Chili and give it to Little Wu

dialogues.speaker: Little Wu
dialogues.text: Jueyun Chilis are a common sight in Liyue. I can rustle that dish up in no time if you help me find some.

dialogues.speaker: Little Wu
dialogues.text: Great, this should be enough.

dialogues.speaker: Little Wu
dialogues.text: I'll get started on the Jueyun Chili Chicken. I guess you've got other folks to track down?

dialogues.speaker: Little Wu
dialogues.text: When everyone's ready, I'll get the dish over to ya.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! See ya later!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Uh... How did he know about the others...?)

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: Ugh... not you again. I told you, I'm not interested in the inner workings of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Meng told us about you. You're good friends, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: That's true, yes. Come to think of it, I remember he did join Wangsheng Funeral Parlor recently.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: It didn't take long for his good friends to figure out why... The Big G incident.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: But I know there's nothing we can say to help him get over it. Letting go of the past is a painful process. I would know...

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: So, is Big G the reason you're here to see me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How did you know!? We didn't even say anything.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm a businessman. I've got a sixth sense for this kind of thing!

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: Everyone hears the name "Mumu" and thinks I must be dim-witted. I never heard the end of it when I set up shop. But... I'd say I've proved a few people wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: Here, take this. It's a top-of-the-line toy box we all dreamed of owning as kids. Back then, none of us could afford it... We were penniless.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: Today, business is booming. I ended up buying loads of these. It was a dream come true.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you must be like, super rich...

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: Haha... For me, it's a memento of a childhood long gone. Without it, we wouldn't be where we are today.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: So, having found me, I guess you'll be looking for Little Wu and Congzi next?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm! We already saw Little Wu, now we gotta find Congzi.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: I see. If it's Congzi you're after, let's meet at the overpass at Feiyun Slope. It's just above the staircase leading down to the dock.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: I've got an errand to run. I'll come find you as soon as I'm done.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? You're all here?

dialogues.speaker: Little Wu
dialogues.text: Reminiscing about old times, thinking back to past events... We've been at it for years.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: Our hometown was completely destroyed in a disaster, so we've got nowhere to go back to. Now, home is wherever friends are.

dialogues.speaker: Congzi
dialogues.text: They've just been telling me you're looking for keepsakes?

dialogues.speaker: Congzi
dialogues.text: I make artisan Xiao Lanterns down by Liyue Harbor. I guess they represent me better than anything.

dialogues.speaker: Congzi
dialogues.text: A few days ago, I bought some quality Plaustrite Shards. They're currently all in the warehouse at the dock.

dialogues.speaker: Congzi
dialogues.text: I've already spoken to the manager. Could I ask you to retrieve them for me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like you already know what's going on! Be back in a jiffy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi, we're here to pick up the Plaustrite Shards for Congzi!

dialogues.speaker: Gou San'er
dialogues.text: ...I think she mentioned it... Yes, here you are in the register. No problem.

dialogues.speaker: Gou San'er
dialogues.text: The Plaustrite Shards are over in that crate there. Please, help yourselves.

talks.objective: Look for a Plaustrite Shard in the pile of goods

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: Y'know, I just realized... mine's the only item that's been outright purchased. Yours are both handmade.

dialogues.speaker: Little Wu
dialogues.text: But yours is worth a lot more.

dialogues.speaker: Congzi
dialogues.text: Worth in Mora is not what's important here. These things all played a big part in our childhood.

dialogues.speaker: Congzi
dialogues.text: They show that we will never forget our promise.

talks.objective: Give the Plaustrite Shard to Congzi

dialogues.speaker: Congzi
dialogues.text: My thanks to both of you, this looks like great stuff. Please wait a moment, this is the final step.

dialogues.speaker: Congzi
dialogues.text: Okay, there we go.

dialogues.speaker: Congzi
dialogues.text: I wrote all five of our names inside the lantern. You know, during the annual Lantern Rite, we all release a lantern like this.

dialogues.speaker: Congzi
dialogues.text: No matter what the days may bring, whichever roads we choose to take... While this rite remains observed, each of us remains the same.

dialogues.speaker: Little Wu
dialogues.text: As for the matter of Big G... The three of us have discussed amongst ourselves and agreed we won't press you on it.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: But if you get the chance, please let him know... we're doing well.

dialogues.speaker: Mumu
dialogues.text: And that the things we once spoke of, they've all come to pass.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thank you, we'll pass it on!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Big G is lucky to have friends like you!

choices.text: And I won't press you on "the things you once spoke of."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we really going with Hu Tao's plan?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At least by keeping things low-key, we won't be giving anyone nightmares.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've got everything we need. Let's go to Wuwang Hill and find Hu Tao and the others.
